answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 25909 Country: India Title: During the swan (roza) time can give 10ml blood to HIV test. Question: assalam o alekum.During the swan (roza) time can give 10ml blood to HIV test. Answer ID: 25909 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1496/1496/M=1431) Blood donation does not nullify the fast. One can give blood at the time of need and compulsion. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
